result.summary: The staleness check is back just before the source_chunk SHORT fallback, after the in-scope FULL and security-path FULL rules. worker_partial joins that check. The fresh-overlap never-HIDE rule for worker_partial sits before it and applies only when the item is fresh or head_sha is None. Stale source_chunk and test_result routing is unchanged, and worker_partial cannot reach the earlier rules. The new tests cover stale source_chunk precedence (in-scope execute and scout, security path, plain stale HIDE) and stale test_result failure precedence. The removed cancel_reason assertion is back in tests/test_worker_control.py. I only read the diff and did not run the tests.
